```{r}
#| label: setup-bayesian
#| include: false
# The outputs of the Bayesian models of the case, which
# companion/_model-outputs/bayes_audit.R fitted once with brms and wrote as
# small CSV files; the deck reads them and fits nothing. Comes after the two
# setup chunks and uses their data and formats.
bayes_counts <- readr::read_csv("../companion/_model-outputs/bayes_audit_counts.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
bayes_draws <- readr::read_csv("../companion/_model-outputs/bayes_audit_draws.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
bayes_summ <- readr::read_csv("../companion/_model-outputs/bayes_audit_summary.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
bayes_dx <- readr::read_csv("../companion/_model-outputs/bayes_audit_diagnostics.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
bayes_sens <- readr::read_csv("../companion/_model-outputs/bayes_audit_sensitivity.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
bayes_ppc <- readr::read_csv("../companion/_model-outputs/bayes_audit_ppc.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
replication <- readr::read_csv("../cases/housing/data/display_replication.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# One row of the summaries for each result quoted on the slides; the gaps are
# in percentage points, Hispanic minus white names
prior_weak <- datawizard::data_filter(bayes_summ, model == "prior_weak", quantity == "gap")
prior_scep <- datawizard::data_filter(bayes_summ, model == "prior_sceptical", quantity == "gap")
prior_white <- datawizard::data_filter(bayes_summ, model == "prior_weak", quantity == "white_share")
orig_weak <- datawizard::data_filter(bayes_summ, model == "original_weak", quantity == "gap")
orig_scep <- datawizard::data_filter(bayes_summ, model == "original_sceptical", quantity == "gap")
repl_alone <- datawizard::data_filter(bayes_summ, model == "replication_alone", quantity == "gap")
repl_upd <- datawizard::data_filter(bayes_summ, model == "replication_updated", quantity == "gap")
joint_orig <- datawizard::data_filter(bayes_summ, model == "joint_common", quantity == "gap_original")
joint_diff <- datawizard::data_filter(bayes_summ, model == "joint_separate", quantity == "difference")
sens_weak <- datawizard::data_filter(bayes_sens, model == "original_weak")
sens_scep <- datawizard::data_filter(bayes_sens, model == "original_sceptical")
sens_upd <- datawizard::data_filter(bayes_sens, model == "replication_updated")
ppc_orig <- datawizard::data_filter(bayes_ppc, model == "joint_common", study == "original")

# The reference specification of the course, with its 95% confidence interval
# from display_outcomes.csv
ref_low <- out_of("named", "hispanic", "ci_low")
ref_high <- out_of("named", "hispanic", "ci_high")

# The design analysis of Gelman and Carlin (2014) in the closed form of the
# retrodesign package (for a normal sampling distribution), for true gaps of 1
# to 25 points, at the standard error of the reference comparison and at that
# of the replication among all its replies
repl_row <- datawizard::data_filter(replication, population == "replies", authorities == "all")
true_gaps <- seq(1, 25, by = 0.5)
design <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tibble::as_tibble(retrodesign::retro_design_closed_form(true_gaps, curve_ref$se_pp)) |>
    datawizard::data_modify(study = "original", true_gap = true_gaps),
  tibble::as_tibble(retrodesign::retro_design_closed_form(true_gaps, repl_row$se_pp)) |>
    datawizard::data_modify(study = "replication", true_gap = true_gaps)
)
d_orig <- datawizard::data_filter(design, study == "original" & true_gap %in% c(2, 4, 10, 20))
d_repl <- datawizard::data_filter(design, study == "replication" & true_gap %in% c(2, 4, 10, 20))
```
